explanation: It ran about 117 km (73 miles) from coast to coast. His successor, Antoninus Pius, built a turf wall further north in Scotland, which Rome abandoned after about 20 years.

claims.text: Emperor Hadrian ordered the building of a wall across northern Britain, begun around AD 122.
Trajan and Claudius did not build the wall, and Antoninus Pius built a different, turf wall further north in the 140s.
Hadrian's Wall ran about 117 km from coast to coast.
The Antonine Wall was built from about AD 142 and abandoned about 20 years later.
